title: A Study of Tersolisib (LY4064809) and Abemaciclib With Hormone Therapies in Participants With PIK3CA-Mutated Early Breast Cancer
official: A Phase 2, Open-label, Randomized Study Investigating the Tolerability of Concurrent Versus Staggered Administration of Abemaciclib and Endocrine Therapy With Tersolisib in Patients With HR+, HER2- Node-Positive, PIK3CA-Mutated Early Breast Cancer.
summary:
The main purpose of this study is to compare two ways of giving the anti-cancer medicines abemaciclib and hormone therapy with tersolisib in participants with early breast cancer that has a genetic mutation (PIK3CA mutation).

For each participant, the study will last up to 56 weeks and include 12 visits.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have histologically or cytologically confirmed breast cancer, defined as individuals with:

  * early stage, resected, invasive breast cancer without evidence of distant metastasis, and
  * have confirmed hormone receptor positive (HR+), human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 negative (HER2-) status defined by

    * Hormone Receptor (HR) status: documented estrogen receptor positive (ER+) and/or progesterone receptor+ tumor, defined as greater than or equal to (≥) 1% of tumor cells stained positive, assessed locally on primary disease specimen, as defined by American Society of Clinical Oncology College of American Pathologists (ASCO/CAP) Guidelines
    * HER status: fulfill the requirement of HER2- disease by local testing on primary disease specimen; tumor must be HER2- according to ASCO/CAP guidelines for HER2 testing
* Have evidence of an activating phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha (PIK3CA) mutation in tumor tissue.
* Must have undergone definitive locoregional therapy, defined as surgery of the primary breast tumor(s), with or without radiation therapy, and/or systemic therapy (neo/adjuvant chemotherapy and or Endocrine Therapy (ET)) per standard guidelines.
* Individuals with bilateral breast cancer (diagnosis of invasive tumors in both breasts simultaneously or within 6 months of each other) may be eligible if all lesions tested on both sides are HR+ HER2- and adequate surgery has been performed for both breasts.
* Tumor involvement in at least 1 axillary lymph node (ALN).

  * ≥ ipsilateral positive ALN, OR
  * 1 to 3 ipsilateral positive ALN and either:

    * tumor size ≥5cm, or
    * histologic Grade 3 tumor (as defined by a combined score of at least 8 points per the modified Bloom-Richardson grading system or equivalent
* Individuals must be randomized within 16 months from the time of definitive breast cancer surgery.
* May have received up to 12 weeks of ET with AIs or tamoxifen until randomization following the last non-ET (surgery, chemotherapy, or radiation), whichever is last.
* Are willing to follow contraception requirements.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have evidence of

  * metastatic disease
  * inflammatory breast cancer at primary breast cancer diagnosis
  * breast cancer recurrence (local, regional, or distant), or
  * a history of previous invasive breast cancer
* Has an established diagnosis of type 1 diabetes mellitus or type 2 diabetes mellitus with Hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) ≥8 percent (%), fasting plasma glucose ≥140 mg/dL (7.7 mmol/L), or requiring insulin.
* Has a history of malignancy other than breast cancer
* Have active Hepatitis B Virus (HBV)
* Have active Hepatitis C Virus (HCV)
* Have untreated Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infection
* Have any other active systemic infection requiring system therapy
* Have a history of Kaposi sarcoma or multicentric Castleman disease
* Have a serious cardiac condition
